summary: Two backpackers stranded in deep snow on the Silver Creek Trail; one with a knee injury, unable to traverse; helicopter extraction
location: Silver Creek Trail, East Avalanche Creek, Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness (Lead King Loop outside Marble)
notes: KVNF regional newscast 2023-07-12: second of two WEMR Silver Creek Trail incidents in three days; helicopter-transported.
